identities.identity_scope: Source-qualified lithium fluoride supplied by the Harshaw Chemical Co. for the NBS powder pattern in section 2.34. NBS reports its spectrographic impurity characterization. This is not all lithium fluoride, a certified grade or a hypothetical crystal model. The density is the source-calculated crystalline-phase value at 25 degrees C, not direct specimen weighing or bulk/powder-packing density. The Table 35 pattern temperature is 26 degrees C. Independent physical-specimen count, repeat count, porosity, sample-specific particle size and conditioning time remain unknown.
